query: In high industry dynamism, do relational and flexible financial pre-commitments yield faster time-to-first-sale and market learning than long-term contractual lock-ins, and why?

response.query: In high industry dynamism, do relational and flexible financial pre-commitments yield faster time-to-first-sale and market learning than long-term contractual lock-ins, and why?
response.answer: In high industry dynamism, relational and flexible financial pre-commitments yield faster time-to-first-sale and market learning than long-term contractual lock-ins due to their adaptability and responsiveness to market changes.
